findings.failureScenario: Two tabs renew within the same tick; the second write restores the expired deadline.
findings.summary: Renewal reads the deadline before the clear and writes it back after.
findings.verification: Traced renew() and clear() call order at the reviewed SHA.

findings.failureScenario: A maintainer reads `d` as a duration and adds milliseconds to an absolute time.
findings.summary: The name `d` hides that it is an absolute deadline.
findings.verification: Read every use of `d` in the module.
